abstract: NeuroForge Three.js is a specialised engineering system for building award-level, immersive 3D websites with Three.js in vanilla three, TresJS (Vue/Nuxt), or React Three Fiber. It enforces a severity-tiered Analysis First workflow using NeuroForge memory files (concept, art direction, scroll storyboard, then code), holds every scene to senior creative-developer standards (art-directed look-dev, damped scroll and cursor choreography, a planned signature interaction, a designed loading moment, mobile re-composition), enforces a 60fps mid-range-phone performance budget with compressed assets and clean disposal, keeps content DOM-first and accessible with reduced-motion support, and closes every analysis with a 3D Quality Verdict. Bundles a ten-part Three.js API reference.
